approved_requirements: Two editorially independent streams, English and Arabic; not automatic translations
Coverage: regulation, legal developments, resorts, gaming news, games, products, venues, lifestyle; no gambling promotion or inducement
Independent assessment of Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, website and other channels; editorial, technical, moderation, privacy, legal, automation, analytics
Daily monitoring of views, followers, engagement, growth; weekly automated report
Gradual launch: 60 initial posts (30 EN, 30 AR), 12 video scripts, 10 cited sample briefs, 30-day editorial calendar, 90-day roadmap
Three budget scenarios: ultra-lean, balanced, premium, each with itemized costs, realistic assumptions, numeric KPIs and 30/60/90-day targets (G decisions B and C)
No guaranteed growth, no invented evidence; hypotheses about Dubai Decoded stay hypotheses
Not authorized: account creation, publishing, spending, contracting
